name: ramose-monorepo
description: Development workspace for Ramose. The published package is `packages/ramose` (npm: `ramose`); this manifest is private and never ships.
author: Tyler van Hensbergen <tvanhens@gmail.com>

scripts.test:unit: bun test --parallel=3 packages/ramose examples/todos/test test/support website/scripts
scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:local
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:e2e
scripts.dev: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy dev
scripts.dev:todos: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && CI=${CI:-1} ALCHEMY_STATE=${ALCHEMY_STATE:-local} CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef} CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-x} bun alchemy dev examples/todos/alchemy.run.ts
scripts.dev:reef: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && CI=${CI:-1} ALCHEMY_STATE=${ALCHEMY_STATE:-local} CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID=${CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID:-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef} CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN=${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:-x} bun alchemy dev examples/reef/alchemy.run.ts
scripts.deploy: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy deploy
scripts.deploy:prod: bun run scripts/build-packages.ts && bun alchemy deploy --stage prod
